CPMImage local modification,2026-11-10: cpmtools2.23 device_libdsk.c geometry fallback preserves odd logical track counts as single-sided rather than dropping the last track. Explicit geometry and successful probes retain priority. See corresponding-source packaging/source/cpmtools-2.23-odd-tracks-libdsk.patch and build recipes. libdsk1.4.2 itself is unchanged.
CPMImage read-only-name modification, 2026-11-10: a dedicated cpmfs-readonly.o accepts colon as opaque directory-name data under CPMIMAGE_READ_ONLY_NAMES. Ordinary CLI objects retain their original validation. See packaging/source/cpmtools-2.23-readonly-names.patch.
